instruction: Navigate to the page that explains how to apply for a learner's permit in Virginia.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the learner's permit application page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify correct URL navigation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) properly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares the actual URL with the expected URL using compare_urls utility
Expected URL (https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/licenses-ids/permit) is semantically correct for Virginia DMV learner's permit page
Complete coverage: instruction only requires navigating to the permit page, evaluator checks that exact requirement
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string -> metric compares -> returns 1.0 if URLs match, 0.0 otherwise
